scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,server,worker,web -c blue,green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @lot-agent/core" "npm run dev -w @lot-agent/server" "npm run dev:worker -w @lot-agent/server" "npm run dev -w @lot-agent/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @lot-agent/desktop && concurrently -n web,electron -c magenta,yellow "npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev -w @lot-agent/desktop"
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build -w @lot-agent/web && npm run dist -w @lot-agent/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop:win: npm run build -w @lot-agent/web && npm run dist:win -w @lot-agent/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop:mac: npm run build -w @lot-agent/web && npm run dist:mac -w @lot-agent/desktop
